svg.title: Aperture Chat — a 75-second tour of the current interface
svg.desc: An animated sequence of actual captures from a synthetic workspace: chat, runtime trace, a generated image, session details, Drafts, a slide deck, agents, knowledge, account security, mobile navigation, help, administration, providers, and shared connectors. Screens are captured states, not a real-time recording.

g.text: Choose a model. Start a conversation.
Review the reply and choose your next step.
Inspect what happened behind the answer.
Develop the answer into a document.
Build slides and refine their visuals.
Find and reference your available sources.
Keep the workspace close at hand.
Follow the walkthroughs at your own pace.
Your models. Your keys. Your workspace.
